dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Smoothly concave trailing edge with a continuous inward spline from the apex to the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small-radius rounded apex forming a narrow, sub-acute point at the fin's maximum vertical pixel coordinate.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin with an approximate 55-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.25:1 ratio of the maximum base pixel width to the maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Uniform medium-radius convex curvature extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a visible length approximately equal to its thickness at the base insertion point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle of approximately 145 degrees at the specific pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform luminescent cyan-green surface texture and low-poly geometric facets on the caudal fluke margins.
